title: Cranes other than mobile and floating cranes - General requirements for stability
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14468) covers Cranes other than mobile and floating cranes - General requirements for stability. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 4304 : 1 987 'Cranes other than mobile and floating cranes — General requirements for stability 1 , issued by International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Equipment Sectional Committee, and approval of the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The text of ISO standard has been approved for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain terminology and conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as Indian Standard'. b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a full stop ( . ) as a decimal marker. The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
